Drag test (vanilla GrapesJS). 1) Left panel se ek block (Text / Box) uthaa kar canvas pe chhodein. 2) Canvas me "Drag me" box ko select karke uske move-handle (✥) se pakad kar upar/neeche move karein.  → Agar yahan drag chalta hai to library theek hai; masla builder config me hai. Agar yahan bhi nahi chalta to library/browser ka masla hai.
